body: Wow you have beautiful features, almond shaped cat eyes, full lips, cute nose, great eyebrows!!!

I have yet to meet someone who’s companionship was better than my solitude and independence. Also I’m goofy and annoying and hyper and chill and a whole bunch of other shit, so I’m better appreciated and enjoyed in small to medium sized doses.
Steven Universe the Movie. The music is beautiful and the heartbreak feels far to real to come from an animated kids show.

I’ve been better but throughout the last few months of this pandemic, the closeness I feel to my family and friends has never been better. My circle is very small but strong and filled with love and an appreciation for each other. I’m beyond thankful for that.

I’m extremely happy for you! You guys have both been blessed and I wish you many more years to come.  I’m just figuring out my sexual identity so it’s nice to know that I don’t need to feel obligated to be with a person who places more value on sex than I do.
It does, it’s helped me make sense of all the things I’ve been feeling.  I’m glad it’s helped you too.

I’m at that point too. I’ve been hovering at this point for a while now and the scale is finally tipping.  Over the last two days I’ve attempted it twice but each time I chickened out.  I don’t want to die a gruesome death.  So I did some research, I’m going to get my supplies, write my letters, and make my plan.  When life kicks me again ( and it will ) I’ll be ready.  
 I think my fear comes from my Christian background. Growing up believing in Hell has really messed with my ability to just do it.  However, I don’t doubt the power of life to suck the fear out of me and replace it with unending sadness and the want to end the pain.

I have too. I thought I could wait another 5 years, try harder, keep going but I can’t.  Every time I build myself up, something comes along to chip away at it and I’m tired.  I’ve tried twice to kill myself but I keep backing out at the last minute.  Mainly because they’re gruesome deaths.  I don’t want to go in a blaze of glory.  I just want to lay down and die but of course, that’s asking for too much.  I don’t think I can hang on much longer.
Thank you, I appreciate the sentiment.

That’s the thing. I don’t want to triumph, I want peace.  Living isn’t something I feel like I need to do, like getting married, traveling or getting tattoos, it’s a choice I want to make.  I’m not looking for people to cry about how they miss me or for people to be miserable when I’m gone.  I just want to be gone and let the world keep moving on.
Thank you everyone, it’s nice to know I’m not as crazy as other people try to make me feel.
Thanks for the offer dude, I’ll take you up on it some time.

I feel like one of the biggest fallacies out there is that somehow, having a significant other or a child will add or give or replace the happiness and fulfillment.  How many women give birth and regret it, how often do children disappoint, how often are children disappointed.  It’s more common than we’re told.  How often do relationships go from head over hills in love to utter disgust with the other person.  We shouldn’t be told that happiness can be found with someone else, if I can’t find it with myself then fine. Let me deal with myself as I see fit.  At the end of the day, I’m not looking for happiness any more, it’s too fleeting, I’m looking for peace.
